description: A text input that filters a list of options as you type, for single or multiple selection.
overview:
`Combobox` pairs a text input with a floating list that filters its `items` as the user types. `ComboboxInput` draws the field with a caret trigger and an optional clear button, and `ComboboxContent` renders the list through a portal (inside a full-window overlay on iOS), positioned below the input and as wide as it.

For multiple selection, set `multiple` and use `ComboboxChips` with a `ComboboxChip` per selected value and a `ComboboxChipsInput` for typing. Each chip has a remove button.
usage:
Pass `items` to the root and render the filtered list with a function child of `ComboboxList`. For grouped items, render a `ComboboxGroup` per group with a `ComboboxLabel` and a `ComboboxCollection`. Add `ComboboxEmpty` for the no-results message.

Use `value`, `defaultValue` and `onValueChange` for the selection, and `inputValue` with `onInputValueChange` for the typed text. For object items, provide `itemToStringLabel`. `filter`, `limit` and `locale` tune matching.

With chips, create a ref with `useComboboxAnchor()`, attach it to `ComboboxChips`, and pass it to `ComboboxContent` as `anchor` so the list lines up with the chips field. On `ComboboxInput`, set `showClear` to add a clear button and `showTrigger={false}` to hide the caret.

examples.Grouped: Items in labelled groups with separators.
examples.Multiple: Multiple selection shown as removable chips.
examples.WithLabel: Linked to a `Label` with helper text.
examples.Invalid: The `invalid` style with an error message.

parts.Combobox: Root that holds the value, input text and open state.
parts.ComboboxInput: Text field with caret trigger and optional clear button.
parts.ComboboxTrigger: Round button that opens the list.
parts.ComboboxItem: Selectable option with a check mark when selected.
parts.ComboboxCollection: Renders the filtered items of a group.
parts.ComboboxChips: Field that holds chips for multiple selection.
parts.ComboboxChip: Selected value with a remove button.
parts.ComboboxChipsInput: Text input inside the chips field.
parts.useComboboxAnchor: Creates a ref for anchoring the popup.

Combobox.items: Items to filter, flat or grouped.
Combobox.onInputValueChange: Called when the input text changes.
Combobox.itemToStringLabel: Converts an item to its display text.
Combobox.filter: Custom match function, or `null` to disable filtering.
Combobox.onOpenChange: Called when the list opens or closes.
Combobox.readOnly: Shows the value without allowing changes.

ComboboxInput.showTrigger: Shows the caret button. Defaults to `true`.
ComboboxInput.showClear: Shows a clear button when there is text or a value.
ComboboxInput.invalid: Shows the danger border; also read from a surrounding Field.

ComboboxContent.side: Side of the anchor to open on. Defaults to `bottom`.
ComboboxContent.align: Alignment against the anchor. Defaults to `start`.
ComboboxContent.sideOffset: Gap from the anchor. Defaults to `6`.
ComboboxContent.anchor: Ref to position against instead of the input.
ComboboxContent.portalHost: Name of the portal host to render into.

ComboboxChip.showRemove: Shows the remove button. Defaults to `true`.

accessibility:
- The input has the `combobox` role with `expanded` and `disabled` state.
- Items have the `option` role with `selected` and `disabled` state; the list has the `list` role.
- The empty message is a polite live region.
- The trigger, clear and chip remove buttons are labelled "Show options", "Clear" and "Remove".
notes:
- Uses `bg-control`, `bg-surface-raised`, `border-focus` and `border-danger` tokens; light and dark follow the system appearance.
- Fade animations respect the system Reduce Motion setting.
